facts.fact: Orange Maroc inaugurated its Orange Tech data centre at Nouaceur (1.5 MW initial capacity, 15,000 square metres, Uptime Institute certification of unstated tier) on 19 November 2025, as part of a B2B offer of cloud services and dedicated IT infrastructure sold to enterprises (Morocco World News).

note: Tier level of the Uptime certification is not stated, so no tier3 fact.
